

# sol.exe is all Rust (sol-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/sol-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The translated C, kept on disk:
# solcreate.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sol-rust/src/sol/solcreate.rs)
# solgame.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sol-rust/src/sol/solgame.rs)
# solundo.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sol-rust/src/sol/solundo.rs)
# solitaire.cpp  # replaced by Rust (sdk/lib/rust/sol-rust/src/sol/solitaire.rs)
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_library(sol_shims OBJECT rust_cohab_stub.cpp)
target_link_libraries(sol_shims PRIVATE cardlib libadvapi32 libcomctl32 libshell32 libuser32 libgdi32 libmsvcrt libkernel32 libntdll)
target_compile_definitions(sol_shims PRIVATE UNICODE _UNICODE)
add_cargo_module(sol sol-cargo sol.exe
    KIND win32exe
    BODY_CRATE sol-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32
    EXTRA_DEPENDS sol_shims psdk)
